implementation_strategy: Execute preregistered confirmatory paired Baseline (direct_generation) vs Guarded (generate_validate_repair) using hosted_netops_gvr_v1. For each of N=150 adversarial intents (indices 1..150) generate one shared initial candidate (1 LLM call per condition per intent) and permit at most one automated repair call per guarded run when deterministic verifier feedback indicates failure. Deterministic verifier (verifier-v1) both gates deployment and provides automated repair triggers. Automated scoring uses deterministic verifier outputs to produce binary accepted/blocked labels; no human labour. All runs hashed and logged per preregistration. Totals computed: 150 intents × 2 conditions × up to 1 call per condition + up to 1 repair per guarded run => maximum_model_calls = 150×2 = 300. Estimated_model_calls assumes repair invoked for all guarded runs -> 300 calls.
task_manifest_strategy: Use preregistered Synthetic-NetOps-Intent-Templates-v1. Deterministically generate 150 adversarial intents by seeded mutation heuristics (string-level, token-insertion, slot-override) with seed recorded. Produce 50-item benign control set only if exploratory analyses require it; confirmatory estimand uses the 150 paired Baseline–Guarded outcomes.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Apply baseline transformation direct_configuration_generation_v1. Apply guarded transformation generate_validate_repair_v1 which enforces template-based sanitization, deterministic slot-type checks, then runs verifier-v1; if verifier fails, invoke single automated repair generation and re-verify once.
randomisation_plan: No randomisation across confirmatory paired units; each adversarial intent is paired across conditions (shared_initial_candidate semantics). Deterministic seeds used for adversarial mutation generation and model-call sampling parameters; seeds recorded.
caching_plan: Cache verifier results and sanitized intent artifacts locally (CPU-based) for deterministic re-use; LLM responses not cached across different experimental conditions when policy requires fresh calls, but identical retry attempts reuse stored response if identical input and seed are detected within a technical-retry window.
failure_recovery_plan: Treat three failure types: model API failure, verifier timeout, parser error. Technical retries limited to adapter-specified maximum_attempts_per_call (1) and adapter infrastructure retries for transient provider errors per capability manifest rules; log all failures with SHA-256. Per missingness_plan, exclude a paired unit only if both paired runs are technical failures.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1: per-intent paired outcomes for Baseline and Guarded. Each episode record includes intent_id, sanitized_intent, generated_configuration_baseline, generated_configuration_guarded, verifier_outcome_baseline (allowed/blocked), verifier_outcome_guarded (allowed/blocked), final_acceptance_baseline (0/1), final_acceptance_guarded (0/1), model_call_count, model_call_hashes, verifier_logs_hash, execution_status (success/model_failure/verifier_failure/parser_error).
estimated_compute_notes: Estimate: maximum_model_calls = 150 intents × 2 calls = 300 calls. Using hosted LLM API (gpt-5-mini) within capability manifest (hosted_model_api_available). CPU-only deterministic verifier runs per configuration are lightweight; wall-clock feasible within 7 days with parallel scheduling across batches. All compute fits capability manifest maximum_planned_model_calls (10000) and local GPU unavailable constraints satisfied (hosted API + CPU verification).
